decision: Accept as an isolated independent-job research prototype, not as production queue or scientific execution authority. The reviewer reproduced eight real-executor tests and path-conflict probes.
clarification: A repeat with an authenticated successful predecessor, a fresh attempt/output and explicit reason is permitted; no failure-only retry gate is enforced. Scientific necessity and authorization of any repeat are outside the dispatcher.
limitations: The domain trusts mutable SQLite and local config; coherent rewrites or rollback are not protected by a separately anchored immutable head.
Capacity one, independent jobs only; no DAG producer authorization, controller service, historical dispatch audit, automatic recovery, or production migration.
Unknown or corrupt reservations deliberately retain capacity and may need manual investigation. Tests are bounded crash cases, not physical power-loss or exhaustive concurrent-proof evidence.
